## TickerWatch — Project owner
Set credentials + cfg in Settings. /brief /stock TICKER EXCHANGE /earnings TICKER EXCHANGE /universe /help /retry. Telegram messages are authorised BEFORE database or AI calls. Use a private chat. Main must run serially. Never overlap manual runs with production collection.

## Collection and source limits
Default: 30 issuer queries per run, round-robin; all universe rows are matched locally. Set max_company_queries=150 only after live load testing. BBC Business preserved through the shared RSS adapter. Broad macro feed uses Google News RSS (best effort; not a guaranteed API).

## Delivery safety
Plain-text chunks, saved before sending. Automatic retries are disabled on Telegram: a timeout may already have delivered. Confirmed failures use /retry; ambiguous/in-flight records require manual review. Sheets persistence failures stop execution.
